serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: #Policeman.Face.lookateachother Policeman: They were taking forever to make my burrito. It’s not my fault! Policewoman: Whatever. Just help me look through that body. There should be an ID on it. Policeman: It stinks! Policewoman: No shit. It has been drifting in this nasty river for quite some time now. Policeman: What do you think happened to him? Policewoman: No idea. Looks like he drowned. Policeman: 3rd person involved? I doubt he went swimming fully clothed in that water. Policewoman: Who knows. Policewoman: I got the ID. Thanks for the help, by the way. Policeman: I’m still eating my burrito! If you wanted my help that much you should’ve waited. Policewoman: We are being paid by case, not by hour, remember? Policeman: Sorry… I will eat it as fast as I can… Policewoman: How can you even swallow it next to that rotten corpse? Policeman: Spicy things always clog my nose… Policewoman: Forget it, I didn’t ask. Policewoman: Nothing more to do here. No witnesses, no signs of struggle or footprints apart from his. But there was a barely smoked joint lying on the bank. Policeman: No way he got that high on that little thing, right? Policewoman: I will send it for testing. Let’s get the cleanup crew and get the hell out of here. Policeman: Couldn’t agree more. It’s chilly out here. Policewoman: … Policewoman: Then maybe next time come on time so that I won’t be forced to stand here for hours, huh? Policeman: R-Right…
